column1: # Shared product node pins (G011 pass 2, checklist step 0). One line per
# qualified kernel build; TestSharedProductPinsMatchTestdata requires
# sharedProductPins to equal these lines exactly.
# Sources (recorded 2026-11-15):
# - release, btf-sha256, gnu-build-id: AL2023 repo kernel RPMs
#   extracted by g011-pass2-pins-20261114/extract-pins.sh; the vmlinuz sha256
#   equals the G011 pass-1 instances' ident and the BTF sha256 equals the
#   pass-1 btf-pin.
# - gnu-build-id: from the RPM vmlinux only; pass 2 preflight must confirm it
#   live from /sys/kernel/notes.
# - qualified-product-elf-sha256 (stage 1): the product objects
#   g19pkg64/128/256/512.bpf.o, in that order, that ran the stage-1 oracle on
#   this pinned build (sharedProductPin.ProductObjects; the product admits
#   only a qualified (kernel, object) pair). Stage 1 builds ONE CO-RE object
#   per profile for every kernel (bpf/build-product.sh; their digests are in
#   shared_product_objects.tsv), so both rows list the same objects. The
#   failure-frame outer/handler symbol columns are gone: the LSM-only exec
#   outcome (D1) attaches no failure-frame probe. The images built from these
#   objects are pinned in shared_product_images.tsv.
# release
